purpose: Fresh structural acceptance cases, separate from en_one and the tuning thanks control.
tuning_policy: Freeze and hash before the first admitted synthesis/model run. Do not tune on these cases or relabel a failed case as tuning; retain every result and revision.

synthesis.provider: preinstalled Apple super-compact voices only; exact MauiSupport VoiceId metadata verified before first synthesis
synthesis.assembly: Synthesize each speech part separately after resource admission. Remove only verified digital-zero leading/trailing padding, preserving every nonzero speech sample. Insert the specified digital-zero pauses. Record original PCM, trimmed sample bounds, assembled PCM hashes and sample rate.
synthesis.missing_voice_behavior: Stop that case as unavailable; do not download, substitute a voice or count it as a pass.

evaluation.text_source: Primary transcript text only; secondary candidates and source/browser mock text cannot satisfy word coverage.
evaluation.normalization: Unicode casefold; ignore punctuation and whitespace differences. Accent folding is allowed for lexical coverage, but does not determine the language assertion.
evaluation.word_coverage: Require every expected content term in order across the primary transcript and each required phrase as contiguous normalized words; permit other grammatical words and punctuation differences.
evaluation.structure: Evaluate live/provisional and final saved-refinement outputs separately. Count the prescribed nonempty reading turns when the actual activity ledger supplies the stated ownership/pause evidence. An unexpected speaker or language barrier must be reported explicitly, not silently skipped or called a structural pass.
evaluation.source_timing: Audio-region bounds only. Do not claim exact word timestamps, sentence alignment or exact punctuation.

reasons: A fresh genuinely spoken single word is a positive control against deleting quiet brief speech while fixing isolated-tail hallucinations.
Keep the full synthesized speech waveform; remove only verified digital-zero padding before gain scaling and never force its duration with a crop.

identity_and_overlap_contract: These single-voice synthetic recipes do not prove diarization accuracy, enrollment calibration, human identity or overlap separation.
For separate overlap regressions, A to A+B to B preserves the switch; A to A+B to A may share a bounded ASR envelope while retaining the raw activity ledger and mixed/ineligible ownership.
Never label an overlap decode as separated per-speaker text. Unknown gaps must contribute no clean track-mapping reference coverage.
Preserve protected edits, revision/CAS checks, immutable saved audio, historical epoch ownership and original confident probe endpoints.

packaged_receipt_contract.gate: Fail closed for missing, stale, mismatched, skipped or unsuccessful required evidence. Source CPU/browser results and ad-hoc model-script outputs cannot satisfy actual signed packaged-model gates.
packaged_receipt_contract.scope: Passing these bounded synthetic cases is structural regression evidence only, not general transcription accuracy or real-meeting robustness.
